env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\[1 2 3\] \[4 5\] \[1 2 3\] \[6\] \[2 3 5\] \[7 8\] \[3 4 7\] \[9\] \[4 5 9\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep -nw 'const' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constkeyword

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

const func pair(a, b int) []int { return []int{a, b, a + b} }

const /*c*/ T1 = []int{1, 2, 3}
const // line
	T2 = [2]int{4, 5}
const
	T3 = pair(1, 2)

const (
	/*c*/ T4 = []int{6}
	T5      = pair(2, 3) // trailing
)

func main() {
	const /*c*/ L1 = []int{7, 8}
	const // line
		L2 = pair(3, 4)
	const (
		L3 = []int{9}
		L4 = pair(4, 5)
	)
	fmt.Println(T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, L1, L2, L3, L4)
}
